blurb: Seair Seaplanes offers scheduled seaplane flights, scenic tours, and private charters connecting Vancouver, Richmond (YVR), Victoria, Nanaimo, Salt Spring Island, and the Gulf Islands. Guests can enjoy aerial views of coastal landscapes, city skylines, and remote wilderness areas. The fleet includes modern and classic seaplanes accommodating from individual travelers to groups.
extraNote: All tours are weather-dependent; changes, delays, or cancellations will be communicated · Departure terminals at Vancouver Harbour, Richmond (YVR), Victoria, Nanaimo, and Gulf Islands as per flight or charter details. · Year-round
